title: Adam and Eve and the garden: Genesis 2–3 in context
description: What the story of Adam and Eve in Genesis 2–3 meant to its first readers: the second creation account, the garden as a sanctuary, the serpent, the tree of knowledge, and how the idea of the fall came later.

title: Cain and Abel explained: Genesis 4 in context
description: The story of Cain and Abel in Genesis 4, read closely: why the offering was refused, sin crouching at the door, "Am I my brother's keeper?", the mark of Cain, and where Cain's wife came from.

title: The Tower of Babel: Genesis 11 in historical context
description: What the Tower of Babel story in Genesis 11 meant to its first readers: Mesopotamian ziggurats, Babylon's great tower Etemenanki, the pun on Babel and confusion, and how the story closes Genesis 1–11.

title: How to read Genesis 1 in its ancient context
description: What Genesis 1 meant to its first readers: the Babylonian exile, the Enuma Elish, the dome of the sky, the image of God, and the Sabbath. A guide to the creation account in its own world.

title: Genesis 1–11 small-group Bible study: a six-week guide
description: A practical six-week plan for leading a small-group Bible study of Genesis 1–11: how to prepare, how to run each session, discussion questions, and how to handle the hard passages. Built on STRATA's free readings.

title: Noah's flood beside Atrahasis and Gilgamesh
description: How the flood story in Genesis 6–9 compares with the older Mesopotamian flood stories in Atrahasis and the Epic of Gilgamesh: what they share, and what Genesis changes.

title: Journaling through grief: a gentle guide for after a loss
description: How to journal through grief without forcing it: what to write in the early days, prompts for later, and how to keep a record of someone you've lost.

title: How to share your journal with your therapist, safely
description: What to talk through before you share journal entries with a therapist, the safer ways to send them, and how Understory's expiring encrypted links work.

title: The venting journal: how to write it out without keeping it
description: How to use a journal to vent safely: getting anger and frustration onto the page, deciding what to keep, and letting the rest go without it becoming part of your story.

title: Is your journal app reading your entries?
description: A plain-language guide to end-to-end encryption for journals: what it protects, what it can't, and exactly what Understory sends to its AI and when.

title: How to start journaling and actually keep going
description: A practical beginner's guide to journaling: how much to write, when to write, what to do on blank days, and how to come back after you've stopped.

title: Journaling prompts for a hard week
description: Gentle journaling prompts for when you're exhausted, grieving or just need to vent, with ways to write when you barely have the energy to start.

title: 台風スウェルで湘南・千葉に波が上がる条件
description: 同じ台風でも、波が上がるポイントと反応しないポイントがあるのはなぜか。湘南・九十九里・南房総のうねりの窓、周期、風から、台風スウェルで波が上がる条件を整理します。

title: 千葉・湘南の初心者向けサーフポイント
description: 湘南・九十九里・南房総の25ポイントから、初心者が入りやすいポイントと避けたいポイントを、海底・レベル・注意点のデータで紹介します。

title: オフショア・潮・周期の読み方
description: Surf Window のスコアは、サイズ・周期・風・潮をポイントごとの条件で採点したもの。オフショア、潮、周期、うねりの向きがどう点数に効くのかを、実際の計算に沿って説明します。

title: サーフィンの波のサイズの見方（ヒザ・コシ・ムネ・アタマ）
description: 波情報の「コシ〜ハラ」「アタマオーバー」は何を表しているのか。沖のうねりの高さと周期から、Surf Window が波のサイズをどう見積もっているかを説明します。

title: 北風の日に千葉で波がいいポイント
description: 九十九里の多くのポイントで北風はオフショアになりません。浜の向きとオフショアの関係から、飯岡や片貝など、北風の日に面がきれいになりやすい千葉のポイントを紹介します。

title: 九十九里のサーフポイントガイド（一宮〜飯岡）
description: 飯岡、片貝、白子、一宮、志田下、太東など、九十九里の12ポイントの特徴と選び方。浜の向き、オフショア、潮、レベル、混雑をデータで比べます。
